With blood and fortune as sacrifices, the young\nking ruled the land.
Praised for his brilliance, he was known as the\n"Black Lion" served by ten brave and mighty\ngenerals known as the "Ten Henchmen".
Was it an honor or was it a responsibility?\nEveryone had been friends since childhood.\nRegardless of their status, they stood with their
arms around one another and there were sparkles in\ntheir eyes. Obscured by the haze of war, their\nvision was still filled with double images.
And then the shadows of destruction crept in\nunnoticed.
No sunlight could reach the land ruled by the\nBlack Lion and a powerful dark magic corrupted the\nsources of water.
Despite relentlessly searching for the cause,\nthe king couldn't even find a single clue.
The king promised to solve the problem and\nencouraged everyone to carry on with their work\nwithout worry...
However, seeing the king wander with a grim look\non his face, people were puzzled.
Under his long-awaited reign, fresh water never\nran out, and the soil was fertile. There was no\nreason for the king to be in sorrow.
Could it be a plague, or perhaps a famine?\nWhat did the Black Lion actually see?
A Servant's Testimony
His Majesty looked up at the moon, trembling.\nStanding on the terrace, His Majesty leaned on the\nalabaster wall and gazed up at the sky once again.
I don't need a concubine, I can always have more\nchildren. But I have only one life...It's sad and\nfrustrating, but I can't die, said His Majesty.
I should love myself. It's the cornerstone of\nliving. That's what life is about. I'm alive,\nthat's right, I'm alive...
Has the king lost it, or is he just imagining\nthings...? While clutching my clothes, I continued\nto observe that bizarre scene.
I will save everyone from this madness and ensure\ntheir prosperity...Now is the time to complete my\ngrand scheme.
The once alabaster castle turned crimson. With\nscreams and cries of rage in his wake, the king\nfought his way out.
He headed to the royal tombs...A hundred feet\nunderground, to the sacred grounds where the past\nrulers rest, and into the dark stone coffin.
Someday, everyone will understand. The horror of\nbecoming complacent in comfort, living a stagnant\nlife. Only through hardship can we become better.
Reeking of blood, the king put on a sincere smile\nfor the first time in a long while.
Until the end of my life...Or even after I become\nnothing but a soul, I will continue to protect\neveryone.
